description: Eric Zimmerman's KAPE: Kroll Artifact Parser and Extractor for targeted forensic collection and processing.
notes: The upstream EZ Tools page does not publish a KAPE version. Version 0 is a bootstrap placeholder; checkver uses the download's Last-Modified header as a package revision, not as the vendor version.
KAPE is free for government, educational, research, and internal company use. As of January 1, 2026, it is no longer available for commercial third-party engagements.
The upstream download does not publish a static SHA256 checksum. The manifest omits hash; Scoop may warn until a hash is populated.

script: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($lastModified)) { throw 'The KAPE download did not return a Last-Modified header.' }
